admission.justification: The obligation is spread over the module that owns the place, the publication and removal callers, the contract and manifest models and the role hand-over, and mcp/tests/test_outside_scratch_root.py pins each part with its own case.

applicability: Every allocation, recreation, removal, completed-retry decision and reconcile deletion.
conditions: The managed parent is created private to the user and refused when it is a symlink, a non-directory, foreign-owned or of any other mode.
The marker must name the same path, generation, enclosure and digest before any bytes are removed.
A markerless tree inside the parent that the same generation is recreating is cleared by design.
exclusions: A recorded root sitting outside the managed parent is reported and left in place.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_outside_scratch_root.py pins the behaviour with 34 cases on candidate tree f8f92ae2; the leaf's test lane records 5 failed and 6025 passed with no candidate-only failure (Worker A3 report).
The pytest harness isolates the outside scratch parent per process and removes only the roots this invocation created.
The changed lines of this file at candidate tree f8f92ae2 are this leaf's call into, record in, or test of the outside scratch mechanisms; mcp/tests/test_outside_scratch_root.py covers the behaviour.
The test support removes each published enclosure's outside scratch root when the run ends, reading it from the manifest or the contract.

statement: Allocation, removal and the completed-retry decision refuse a parent that is a symlink, a non-directory, foreign-owned or not mode 0700, refuse a root that is a symlink, that escapes the parent or that lies outside it, and delete nothing before the marker names the same path, generation, enclosure and digest the record carries.
